Experience

2026

AI comics & storyboard generation

Technical lead

Helped shape the system architecture and core workflow, connecting script understanding, asset extraction, and storyboard generation. Led quality evaluation and acceptance criteria, with recovery mechanisms for long-running generation tasks.

Fixed evaluation set: action-overload and shot-scale issues fell from about 18% to 9.53%. One 20-episode run completed despite intermediate failures.

Work & outcomes
  • Decomposed scripts into structured multi-shot storyboards, enforcing independent quality grading and bounded-cost auto-correction.
  • On a fixed evaluation set, action-overload and shot-scale issues fell from about 18% to 9.53%—a relative reduction of about 47%.
  • Added circuit breaking, concurrency control, and bounded recovery; a 20-episode run completed despite intermediate failures.
2025–2026

Short-drama editing & character identity

Workstream lead

Solved character drift across episodic short dramas via cross-episode identity tracking, entity alignment, and highlight retrieval, keeping automated cuts locked onto the main cast.

One 10-episode sample: identity disambiguation fell from 1,285s to 24s; understanding orchestration fell from 23 minutes to about 5–6 minutes.

Work & outcomes
  • Improved data services, concurrent scheduling, and cache reuse to support the editing pipeline.
  • On one 10-episode sample, identity disambiguation fell from 1,285 to 24 seconds; understanding orchestration fell from 23 minutes to about 5–6 minutes.
2025

E-commerce copy style adaptation

Core algorithm engineering

Engineered an end-to-end stylized copywriting pipeline for digital human livestreams, spanning automated dataset synthesis, supervised fine-tuning (Qwen2.5-7B), and multi-metric evaluation.

Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B for five copy styles.

Work & outcomes
  • Designed a source-text → style-profile → rewrite dataset workflow and multidimensional automatic evaluation.
  • Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B for five copy styles, using structured style information to stabilize training.
2024

Enterprise RAG, safety & intent recognition

Core algorithm engineering

Worked on enterprise document Q&A, internal LLM safety review, and voice-bot intent recognition, covering retrieval, generation, and interaction quality.

Internal tests reported about 90% recall and Q&A accuracy.

Work & outcomes
  • Architected an enterprise RAG system with hierarchical document trees and hybrid retrieval, achieving ~90% recall and answer accuracy in internal benchmarks.
  • Combined semantic matching and rules for content review, supporting the internal model registration process.
  • Used Aho–Corasick matching and inverted indexes for intent recognition across scenarios.
2022–2024

Intelligent search & conversation analysis

NLP algorithm trainee

Worked on intelligent search, Text2SQL, and social-media support conversations, covering query understanding, similar-question grouping, and discovery of unanswered questions.

Work & outcomes
  • Generated SQL templates from database schemas and plain-language explanations for business review.
  • Used contrastive sentence embeddings and hierarchical density clustering to expand question libraries and support conversation reporting.

工作经历

2026

AI 漫剧生成系统

项目技术侧负责人

统筹端到端技术方案，打通剧本理解、角色资产提取与分镜生成全流程；建立自动化质检与验收标准，让长生成任务可评估、能自愈。

固定评测集：动作过载与景别失当问题率约 18% → 9.53%。一次真实运行中，20 集任务遇中间报错自动恢复，完整跑完。

展开工作与成果
  • 拆解结构化分镜与多镜头生成，引入独立的质检打分与有成本上限的纠错机制。
  • 在固定评测集上，动作过载与景别失当问题率由约 18% 降至 9.53%（相对降低约 47%）。
  • 落地 LLM 熔断、动态并发与断点自愈；在 20 集长任务实测中，遇偶发报错可自动恢复并完成交付。
2025–2026

短剧智能剪辑与人物身份一致性

方向主导

针对多集短剧剪辑中人物“忽变、认错”的痛点，设计跨集角色对齐与高光检索链路，让自动化剪辑始终咬住同一主角。

一个 10 集测试样本：身份消歧 1285 秒 → 24 秒；理解调度 23 分钟 → 约 5–6 分钟。

展开工作与成果
  • 优化底层数据服务、并发调度与特征缓存，将多模态模型接入高并发的成片管线。
  • 在 10 集测试样本中，角色消歧耗时从 1285 秒降至 24 秒（耗时减少约 98%）；理解调度从 23 分钟缩短至约 5–6 分钟。
2025

电商文案风格化

核心算法工程师

为数字人带货场景打造商品文案风格化改写链路，覆盖训练集构建、模型微调到自动化评测全流程。

基于 Qwen2.5-7B 完成 SFT，支持 5 类文案风格。

展开工作与成果
  • 设计“原文—风格画像—改写文案”的数据生成管道，配合多维度自动评测保证改写质量。
  • 基于 Qwen2.5-7B 完成监督微调（SFT），支持 5 种文案风格，并利用结构化风格约束解决训练 loss 震荡问题。
2024

企业文档问答、安全审核与意图识别

核心算法工程师

负责企业级 RAG 问答、大模型安全审核与语音机器人意图识别，围绕检索准确率与交互质量打磨完整链路。

内部测试：召回率与问答准确率约 90%。

展开工作与成果
  • 结合文档段落层级树、多路召回与动态阈值过滤，内部测试集召回率与问答准确率达约 90%。
  • 结合向量语义匹配与规则过滤搭建内容风控体系，顺利支持内部大模型算法备案。
  • 使用 AC 自动机与倒排索引优化关键词匹配，大幅提升多意图识别的速度与召回率。
2022–2024

智能搜索与会话分析

NLP 算法管培

参与智能搜索、Text2SQL 与社媒咨询会话分析，承担查询理解、相似问法聚合和未知问题发现模块。

展开工作与成果
  • 基于数据库 Schema 自动生成 SQL 模板与口语化业务解释，方便非技术人员直观校验。
  • 基于对比学习句向量与层次聚类（HDBSCAN），从海量咨询记录中自动挖掘高频新问题，持续沉淀知识库。
